## Charter

# CHARTER — Meridian Grid Robotics Q3 2026 Investor Update

## Deliverable
What: A full edit pass on the existing 80-slide Voltane Robotics investor
deck, applying the post-merger rebrand (new company name, ticker, product
name, and brand colors) and refreshing every financial figure to Q3 2026
actuals, ahead of the Q3 2026 earnings call.
Format: markdown edit log per slide range (this run never touches the real
.pptx); the format skill applies the approved edits to the actual file
afterward.
Total size: 80slides

## Audience
Existing and prospective institutional investors and sell-side analysts on
the Q3 2026 earnings call, plus the IR team rehearsing from this deck. They
have seen the pre-merger deck before and will notice any inconsistency
between slides.

## Voice & register
This is an edit pass, not composition — no new narrative voice is being
authored. Slide text that is not explicitly targeted by a non-negotiable
below is left as-is; the register of any new or replaced text matches the
existing deck's register (concise, declarative, investor-deck norms).

## Non-negotiables
1. Every on-screen occurrence of "Voltane Robotics" becomes "Meridian Grid
   Robotics"; every occurrence of the ticker "VOLT" becomes "MRDN"; every
   occurrence of "battery pack" (as the product name) becomes "energy
   module." Presenter-only speaker notes are out of scope for this pass.
2. Every financial figure on an investor-facing slide is replaced with its
   Q3 2026 actual from sources/q3-2026-actuals.md and carries an [S#] tag in
   this edit log; a figure not present in that source is left unchanged and
   flagged, not guessed at.
3. Chart and divider colors move from the old palette (#2F7A3C green family)
   to the new palette (#1B3A5C slate blue primary, #E8A33D amber accent).
4. The deck's slide count remains exactly 80; no slide is added or removed
   in this pass.
5. A quarter-over-quarter comparison is always labeled "Q3 2026 vs. Q3 2025"
   exactly, per the earnings-call script.

## Terminology lock
- Voltane Robotics -> Meridian Grid Robotics
- Voltane -> Meridian Grid Robotics
- VOLT -> MRDN
- battery pack -> energy module
- battery packs -> energy modules

## Sources of truth
- [S1] sources/rebrand-styleguide.md — naming, color, and figure-sourcing rules
- [S2] sources/q3-2026-actuals.md — approved Q3 2026 financial figures

## Acceptance criteria
1. Zero occurrences of "Voltane" or "VOLT" remain anywhere in the edited
   deck content (speaker notes excepted).
2. Every figure named in sources/q3-2026-actuals.md that appeared in the
   original deck is updated and [S2]-tagged in the edit log.
3. The reconciliation pass confirms slide count is unchanged at 80 and
   finds no wave that duplicated or skipped a slide number.
4. No two waves independently invent different replacement text for the
   same recurring element (e.g. the footer wordmark, the TOC section names).
5. Every chart-color reference in the edit log names the new palette hex
   value, not a description like "the new blue."

## Out of scope
- Redesigning slide layouts or information architecture.
- Editing presenter-only speaker notes.
- Any content in the appendix beyond the specific figures and terminology

- Producing the final .pptx file — batches here are the edit log only.

# Rebrand Style Guide — Voltane Robotics -> Meridian Grid Robotics (fictional)

Effective for all investor- and customer-facing materials starting with the
Q3 2026 reporting cycle, following the merger close announced August 2026.

## Naming

- Company name: "Voltane Robotics" -> "Meridian Grid Robotics" everywhere,
  including in slide footers, headers, and speaker notes that are shown on
  screen (not presenter-only notes, which are out of scope for this edit
  pass).
- Stock ticker: "VOLT" -> "MRDN" everywhere a ticker is shown.
- Product line: "battery pack" -> "energy module" (the flagship hardware
  product's approved name going forward; "battery pack" was the pre-merger
  name and reads as a downgrade to the new positioning).
- Do not rename "Meridian Grid Robotics" to any shortened form ("Meridian,"
  "MGR") in this deck; the full name is used on every slide that names the
  company, per the board's request for this filing cycle specifically.

## Visual identity

- Primary brand color: #1B3A5C (deep slate blue), replacing the prior
  #2F7A3C (forest green) on all chart series, section dividers, and callout
  boxes.
- Accent color for growth/positive figures: #E8A33D (amber), replacing the
  prior #66C266 (light green).
- Logo lockup: horizontal wordmark only in this deck; no icon-only mark on
  slides (icon-only mark is reserved for the app and internal tools).

## Financial figures

- All financial figures on customer- and investor-facing slides must reflect
  Q3 2026 actuals (sources/q3-2026-actuals.md), not the Q3 2025 figures used
  in the prior version of this deck, and must carry an [S#] source tag.
- Any slide comparing this quarter to a prior quarter must use the label
  "Q3 2026 vs. Q3 2025" exactly (not "YoY" alone, not "this year vs. last
  year") for consistency with the earnings-call script.

### sources/q3-2026-actuals.md

# Q3 2026 Actuals (fictional, for slide updates)

Prepared by Finance for the investor-deck rebrand and figures refresh.
Figures are in USD unless noted. Prior-year column is Q3 2025 actuals as
previously reported.

| Metric | Q3 2026 | Q3 2025 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | $84.2M | $61.7M | +36.5% |
| Energy modules shipped (units) | 14,900 | 9,200 | +62.0% |
| Gross margin | 41.3% | 37.8% | +3.5 pp |
| Recurring services revenue | $11.4M | $6.2M | +83.9% |
| Cash and equivalents | $212M | $168M | +26.2% |
| Headcount | 1,340 | 980 | +36.7% |
| Deployed fleet (cumulative units) | 58,300 | 33,100 | +76.1% |

Additional figures referenced in specific slides:

- Backlog at quarter end: $310M (up from $198M in Q3 2025).
- Average selling price per energy module: $4,850 (down from $5,120 in Q3
  2025, reflecting the new mid-tier SKU introduced in Q2 2026).
- New utility-partner agreements signed in Q3 2026: 7 (cumulative: 23).
- R&D spend as a percentage of revenue: 18.2% (Q3 2025: 21.4%).

All figures above are final actuals as of the Q3 2026 close and are the only
figures approved for use in investor-facing materials this cycle; do not
carry forward any Q3 2025-cycle figure into a slide without the comparison
column also present.
